purpose: Test whether a pre-existing JANUS first-break localization operator, developed before the viral mirror branch, extracts predictive information from external viral molecular-dynamics trajectories beyond aggregate trajectory summaries.

external_target.title: Molecular dynamic trajectory videos and analysis information for Madariaga and NA-EEEV viruses with complexed VLDLR receptor
selection_basis_seen_before_freeze: record metadata states that Desmond trajectories are provided
record metadata states that raw RMSD and MM-GBSA analysis data are provided
systems include MADV-BRA, MADV-PAN, EEEV and CHIKV bound to human VLDLR
forbidden_before_freeze: paper result/discussion conclusions about relative stability

frozen_hypothesis.name: EARLY_FIRST_BREAK_PREDICTS_LATE_ENERGETIC_STATE
frozen_hypothesis.claim: Across receptor-bound viral MD systems, the location and magnitude of the earliest persistent RMSD regime break in the early trajectory carries information about the later energetic state that is not captured by the early-window mean RMSD alone.
frozen_hypothesis.scientific_scope: computational trajectory analysis only; no wet-lab, pathogenicity, treatment or gain-of-function claim

frozen_analysis.time_normalization: map each trajectory to fractional progress u in [0,1]

first_break_detector.candidate_break: earliest point after baseline where a two-segment mean model improves SSE over one-segment mean model by >=25% and the post-break mean shift persists for >=10% of the feature window

frozen_analysis.withheld_outcome: late-window MM-GBSA central tendency/rank if time-resolved values are available; otherwise the narrowest pre-existing per-system MM-GBSA endpoint in the dataset
frozen_analysis.primary_test: leave-one-virus-out rank prediction: compare first-break feature model versus aggregate-baseline model for predicting late energetic rank; first-break must reduce absolute rank error in >=3 of 4 held-out systems
frozen_analysis.secondary_test: Spearman association of frozen first-break severity with late energetic state must exceed the association of early mean RMSD with that outcome
null_controls: within-system random circular time shift applied before first-break detection
time-order permutation preserving the RMSD value multiset
frozen_analysis.null_requirement: real ordering must outperform >=95% of deterministic/permutation null scores where enumeration is feasible; otherwise NO_PASS
frozen_analysis.ambiguity_rule: ties, missing MM-GBSA alignment, or insufficient sampling remain UNRESOLVED and cannot be converted to PASS
frozen_analysis.selection_firewall: no system may be dropped after values are viewed except for a pre-declared parse failure; all exclusions must be recorded

promotion_gate.method_signal: PASS only if primary test and null requirement pass
required_after_method_signal: second independently authored viral raw-trajectory dataset
